## Job Title
Software Engineer

## Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and driven Software Engineer with strong Scala and SAAS skills to our dedicated technology team. As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for constructing quality, reliable, and efficient technologies and services. 

## Required Skills
1. Proven ability in Scala programming language for at least three years in software engineering position.
2. Demonstrated knowledge in Software as a Service (SAAS) technologies with the ability to manipulate services to desired states and functions.

## Required Experience
1. Minimum three-year experience working as a Software Engineer.

## Responsibilities
1. Analyze, design and develop tests and tools for software enhancements and new products.
2. Contribute to the design, development, validation, and delivery of the software technologies and best practices.
3. Collaborate cross-functionally with business users, project managers, and other engineers to achieve elegant solutions.
